description:
You are a mechanical engineer at an HVAC retrofit firm. The owner of the 4StoreyBuilding has approved a capital improvement project to replace all rooftop units (RTUs) on the top floor (T.*) with high-efficiency units. The existing units are aging standard-efficiency equipment. Your job is to update the energy simulation model to reflect the new equipment performance specifications before presenting the predicted savings to the owner.

You must update ALL Top Floor (T.*) packaged single-zone (PSZ) HVAC systems in eQUEST with the following new equipment parameters:
- Cooling Energy Input Ratio (COOLING-EIR): change from the current value to 0.28571 (equivalent to EER 3.5 at ARI conditions, representing a modern high-efficiency RTU)
- Furnace Heat Input Ratio (FURNACE-HIR): change from the current value to 1.11111 (equivalent to 90% AFUE, representing a condensing furnace upgrade)
- Supply fan efficiency (SUPPLY-EFF): change from the current value to 0.65 (representing premium efficiency fan motors with VFD-equivalent performance)

After updating all top-floor systems, run the full annual DOE-2.2 simulation to compute predicted annual energy savings. Save the project when complete.

You must identify and update all Top Floor systems independently. The number of systems on the top floor is not provided.
